cond_0001.intro: Approves new supplier's quality and production systems to ensure that [Company name masked]'s purchased parts meet product specifications. Integral part of new product launches including both supplier and parts development for manufacturing.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Supports the Module Quality Engineer(s) in advanced quality planning activities such as risk assessment, product and process development.
Communicates with other [Company name masked] plants in the worldwide [Company name masked] Network including joint problem solving.
Executes the process series before Start of Production (SOP) with the suppliers (world-wide).
Supports launch projects after hand over to Supplier Quality Assurance ensuring compliance with [Company name masked] specifications.
Conducts the Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) releases for assigned products.
Supports new and challenging supplier's quality and production systems.
Reviews the monthly supplier rating.
Performs product and process audits due to occurred errors and supplier rating results and initiates counteractions and counteraction verification.
Leads 8D quality problem solving process for supplier related issues.
Conducts requalification audits for the quality management system at the supplier location(s).
Validates start up ability for new parts/processes.

Coordinates reduction of supplier related warranty claims via Defect Eradication Process.
Participates in internal warranty reduction problem solving teams regarding purchased parts.
Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in Engineering or related field, or the equivalent of 4 years of professional supplier quality process/components experience in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Automotive experience.
Experience with Tier Supplier or OEM.
6+ Years (5+ years with a master's degree) of professional experience in the related part technology and/or processing.
5+ Years of knowledge in advanced quality planning techniques, including PFMEA, control planning, process flow diagramming, process auditing techniques, and PPAP.
5+ Years of knowledge of advanced statistical techniques such as capability and standard deviation studies to calculate process variation.

5+ Years of Microsoft Office skills (Word, Access, Excel, etc.).
German or Spanish language.

cond_0079.responsibilities:
Supports the Module Quality Engineer(s) in advanced quality planning activities such as risk assessment, product and process development.
Coordinates with other [Company name masked] plants in the worldwide [Company name masked] Network on joint problem solving.
Executes the process series before Start of Production (SOP) with suppliers (world-wide).
Supports launch projects after hand over to Supplier Quality Assurance ensuring compliance with [Company name masked] specifications.
Conducts the Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) releases for assigned products.
Supports new and challenging supplier quality and production systems.
Reviews the monthly supplier rating.
Performs product and process audits due to occurred errors and supplier rating results and initiates counteractions and counteraction verification.
Leads 8D quality problem solving process for supplier related issues.
Conducts requalification audits for the quality management system at supplier location(s).
Validates start up ability for new parts and processes.
Contributes to the part approval process for assigned suppliers.
Coordinates reduction of supplier related warranty claims via Defect Eradication Process.
Participates in internal warranty reduction problem solving teams regarding purchased parts.
Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0079.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in Engineering or related field, or equivalent of 4 years of professional supplier quality process/components experience in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Automotive experience.
Experience with Tier Supplier or OEM.
6+ Years (5+ years with a master's degree) of professional experience in the related part technology and/or processing.
5+ Years of knowledge in advanced quality planning techniques, including PFMEA, control planning, process flow diagramming, process auditing techniques, and PPAP.
Preferred Requirements
5+ Years of knowledge of advanced statistical techniques such as capability and standard deviation studies to calculate process variation.
5+ Years of Microsoft Office skills (Word, Access, Excel, etc.).
German or Spanish language skills.

cond_0189.intro: We are looking for a Supplier Quality Engineer II to join our team.
cond_0189.responsibilities:
Coordinate with Module Quality Engineer(s) on advanced quality planning activities such as risk assessment, product and process development.
Share updates and collaborate with other [Company name masked] plants across the worldwide network, including joint problem solving.
Work alongside suppliers (worldwide) to carry out the process series before Start of Production (SOP).
Support launch projects after handover to Supplier Quality Assurance, helping ensure compliance with [Company name masked] specifications.
Coordinate the Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) releases for assigned products.
Support new and challenging supplier quality and production systems.
Review the monthly supplier rating together with relevant stakeholders.
Conduct product and process audits due to occurred errors and supplier rating results, and work with suppliers to initiate and verify counteractions.
Facilitate the 8D quality problem solving process for supplier-related issues.
Conduct requalification audits for the quality management system at supplier locations.
Validate start-up ability for new parts and processes.
Collaborate on the part approval process for assigned suppliers.
Coordinate reduction of supplier-related warranty claims via the Defect Eradication Process.
Participate in internal warranty reduction problem solving teams regarding purchased parts.
Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0189.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in Engineering or related field, or equivalent 4 years of professional supplier quality process/components experience in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Automotive experience.
Experience with Tier Supplier or OEM.
6+ Years (5+ years with a master's degree) of professional experience in the related part technology and/or processing.
5+ Years of knowledge in advanced quality planning techniques, including PFMEA, control planning, process flow diagramming, process auditing techniques, and PPAP.
Preferred Requirements
5+ Years of knowledge of advanced statistical techniques such as capability and standard deviation studies to calculate process variation.
5+ Years of Microsoft Office skills (Word, Access, Excel, etc.).
German or Spanish language.

cond_0228.intro: Approves new supplier's quality and production systems to ensure that [Company name masked]'s purchased parts meet product specifications. Integral part of new product launches including both supplier and parts development for manufacturing.
cond_0228.responsibilities:
Supports the Module Quality Engineer(s) in advanced quality planning activities such as risk assessment, product and process development.
Communicates with other [Company name masked] plants in the worldwide [Company name masked] Network including joint problem solving.
Executes the process series before Start of Production (SOP) with the suppliers (world-wide).
Supports launch projects after hand over to Supplier Quality Assurance ensuring compliance with [Company name masked] specifications.
Conducts the Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) releases for assigned products.
Supports new and challenging supplier's quality and production systems.
Reviews the monthly supplier rating.
Performs product and process audits due to occurred errors and supplier rating results and initiates counteractions and counteraction verification.
Leads 8D quality problem solving process for supplier related issues.
Conducts requalification audits for the quality management system at the supplier location(s).
Validates start up ability for new parts/processes.
Collaborates on the part approval process for assigned suppliers.
Coordinates reduction of supplier related warranty claims via Defect Eradication Process.
Participates in internal warranty reduction problem solving teams regarding purchased parts.
Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0228.requirements:
BS degree in Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience, or around 4 years of professional supplier quality process/components experience in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Some background in automotive is expected.
Experience with a Tier Supplier or OEM is helpful.
Around 6 years (or 5+ years with a master's degree) of experience in the related part technology and/or processing, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Around 5 years of familiarity with advanced quality planning techniques, including PFMEA, control planning, process flow diagramming, process auditing techniques, and PPAP.
Around 5 years of exposure to advanced statistical techniques such as capability and standard deviation studies to calculate process variation.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Access, Excel, etc.) built over around 5 years or equivalent.
German or Spanish language skills are a plus.

Coordinate with Module Quality Engineer(s) on advanced quality planning activities such as risk assessment, product and process development.
Share updates and collaborate with other [Company name masked] plants across the worldwide network, including joint problem solving.
Work alongside suppliers (worldwide) to carry out the process series before Start of Production (SOP).
Support launch projects after handover to Supplier Quality Assurance, helping ensure compliance with [Company name masked] specifications.
Coordinate the Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) releases for assigned products.
Support new and challenging supplier quality and production systems.
Review the monthly supplier rating together with relevant stakeholders.
Conduct product and process audits due to occurred errors and supplier rating results, and work with suppliers to initiate and verify counteractions.
Facilitate the 8D quality problem solving process for supplier-related issues.
Conduct requalification audits for the quality management system at supplier locations.
Validate start-up ability for new parts and processes.
Collaborate on the part approval process for assigned suppliers.
Coordinate reduction of supplier-related warranty claims via the Defect Eradication Process.
Participate in internal warranty reduction problem solving teams regarding purchased parts.
Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in Engineering or related field, or equivalent 4 years of professional supplier quality process/components experience in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Automotive experience.
Experience with Tier Supplier or OEM.
6+ Years (5+ years with a master's degree) of professional experience in the related part technology and/or processing.
5+ Years of knowledge in advanced quality planning techniques, including PFMEA, control planning, process flow diagramming, process auditing techniques, and PPAP.
Preferred Requirements
5+ Years of knowledge of advanced statistical techniques such as capability and standard deviation studies to calculate process variation.
5+ Years of Microsoft Office skills (Word, Access, Excel, etc.).
German or Spanish language.

cond_0272.intro: Approves new supplier's quality and production systems to ensure that [Company name masked]'s purchased parts meet product specifications. Integral part of new product launches including both supplier and parts development for manufacturing.
cond_0272.responsibilities:
Supports the Module Quality Engineer(s) in advanced quality planning activities such as risk assessment, product and process development.
Communicates with other [Company name masked] plants in the worldwide [Company name masked] Network including joint problem solving.
Executes the process series before Start of Production (SOP) with the suppliers (world-wide).
Supports launch projects after hand over to Supplier Quality Assurance ensuring compliance with [Company name masked] specifications.
Conducts the Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) releases for assigned products.
Supports new and challenging supplier's quality and production systems.
Reviews the monthly supplier rating.
Performs product and process audits due to occurred errors and supplier rating results and initiates counteractions and counteraction verification.
Leads 8D quality problem solving process for supplier related issues.
Conducts requalification audits for the quality management system at the supplier location(s).
Validates start up ability for new parts/processes.
Collaborates on the part approval process for assigned suppliers.
Coordinates reduction of supplier related warranty claims via Defect Eradication Process.
Participates in internal warranty reduction problem solving teams regarding purchased parts.
Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0272.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in Engineering or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Alternatively, a minimum of 4 years of demonstrated expertise in supplier quality processes/components in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Substantial automotive industry experience.
Proven track record working with Tier Suppliers or OEMs.
Minimum 6 years of demonstrated expertise in the related part technology and/or processing (minimum 5 years with a master's degree).
Minimum 5 years of deep knowledge of advanced quality planning techniques, including PFMEA, control planning, process flow diagramming, process auditing techniques, and PPAP.
Minimum 5 years of advanced knowledge of statistical techniques such as capability and standard deviation studies to calculate process variation.
Preferred Requirements
Strong command of Microsoft Office (Word, Access, Excel, etc.), developed over 5 or more years.
Proficiency in German or Spanish.

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of quality and process problems the work involves.
cond_0283.responsibilities:
Supports the Module Quality Engineer(s) in advanced quality planning activities such as risk assessment, product and process development.
Communicates with other [Company name masked] plants in the worldwide [Company name masked] Network including joint problem solving.
Executes the process series before Start of Production (SOP) with the suppliers (world-wide).
Supports launch projects after hand over to Supplier Quality Assurance ensuring compliance with [Company name masked] specifications.
Conducts the Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) releases for assigned products.
Supports new and challenging supplier's quality and production systems.
Reviews the monthly supplier rating.
Performs product and process audits due to occurred errors and supplier rating results and initiates counteractions and counteraction verification.
Leads 8D quality problem solving process for supplier related issues.
Conducts requalification audits for the quality management system at the supplier location(s).
Validates start up ability for new parts/processes.
Collaborates on the part approval process for assigned suppliers.
Coordinates reduction of supplier related warranty claims via Defect Eradication Process.
Participates in internal warranty reduction problem solving teams regarding purchased parts.
Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0283.requirements:
BS degree in Engineering or related field or the equivalent of 4 years of professional supplier quality process/components experience in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Automotive Experience
Experience with Tier Supplier or OEM
6+ Years (5+ years with a master's degree) of professional experience in the related part technology and/or processing.
5+ Years of knowledge in advanced quality planning techniques, including PFMEA, control planning, process flow diagramming, process auditing techniques, and PPAP.
5+ Years of knowledge of advanced statistical techniques such as capability and standard deviation studies to calculate process variation.
5+ Years of Microsoft Office skills (Word, Access, Excel, etc.).
German or Spanish language

cond_0332.responsibilities:
Lead advanced quality planning activities alongside Module Quality Engineer(s), including risk assessment and product and process development.
Drive communication with other [Company name masked] plants across the worldwide [Company name masked] Network, including joint problem solving.
Execute the process series before Start of Production (SOP) with suppliers worldwide.
Own launch project support after handover to Supplier Quality Assurance, ensuring compliance with [Company name masked] specifications.
Conduct and deliver Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) releases for assigned products.
Direct support for new and challenging supplier quality and production systems.
Review the monthly supplier rating.
Perform product and process audits due to occurred errors and supplier rating results, and take ownership of initiating counteractions and counteraction verification.
Lead the 8D quality problem solving process for supplier-related issues.
Conduct requalification audits for the quality management system at supplier locations.
Validate start-up ability for new parts and processes.
Drive the part approval process for assigned suppliers.
Lead reduction of supplier-related warranty claims via the Defect Eradication Process.
Execute internal warranty reduction problem solving for purchased parts.
Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0332.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in Engineering or a related field, or equivalent 4 years of professional supplier quality process/components experience in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Automotive experience.
Experience with Tier Supplier or OEM.
6+ Years (5+ years with a master's degree) of professional experience in the related part technology and/or processing.
5+ Years of knowledge in advanced quality planning techniques, including PFMEA, control planning, process flow diagramming, process auditing techniques, and PPAP.
Preferred Requirements
5+ Years of knowledge of advanced statistical techniques such as capability and standard deviation studies to calculate process variation.
5+ Years of Microsoft Office skills (Word, Access, Excel, etc.).
German or Spanish language skills.

cond_0456.intro: We are looking for a Supplier Quality Engineer II to join our team. This role approves new suppliers' quality and production systems to ensure purchased parts meet product specifications, and is an integral part of new product launches including supplier and parts development for manufacturing.
cond_0456.responsibilities:
Supports the Module Quality Engineer(s) in advanced quality planning activities such as risk assessment, product and process development.
Communicates regularly with other [Company name masked] plants in the worldwide [Company name masked] Network, including joint problem solving.
Executes the process series before Start of Production (SOP) with suppliers worldwide, staying in close contact throughout.
Supports launch projects after hand over to Supplier Quality Assurance, ensuring compliance with [Company name masked] specifications.
Conducts the Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) releases for assigned products.
Supports new and challenging supplier quality and production systems.
Reviews the monthly supplier rating.
Performs product and process audits due to occurred errors and supplier rating results, and initiates counteractions and counteraction verification.
Leads 8D quality problem solving process for supplier related issues, actively coordinating with relevant parties to drive resolution.
Conducts requalification audits for the quality management system at supplier locations.
Validates start up ability for new parts/processes.
Collaborates closely with suppliers on the part approval process for assigned accounts.
Coordinates reduction of supplier related warranty claims via Defect Eradication Process.
Participates actively in internal warranty reduction problem solving teams regarding purchased parts.
Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0456.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in Engineering or related field, or 4 years of professional supplier quality process/components experience in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Automotive experience.
Experience with Tier Supplier or OEM.
6+ Years (5+ years with a master's degree) of professional experience in the related part technology and/or processing.
5+ Years of knowledge in advanced quality planning techniques, including PFMEA, control planning, process flow diagramming, process auditing techniques, and PPAP.
5+ Years of knowledge of advanced statistical techniques such as capability and standard deviation studies to calculate process variation.
5+ Years of Microsoft Office skills (Word, Access, Excel, etc.).
Preferred Requirements
German or Spanish language skills.

cond_0468.intro: We are looking for a Supplier Quality Engineer II to join our team. This role supports approval of new suppliers' quality and production systems to help ensure purchased parts meet product specifications, and is an integral part of new product launches including supplier and parts development for manufacturing.
cond_0468.responsibilities:
Coordinates with Module Quality Engineer(s) on advanced quality planning activities such as risk assessment, product and process development.
Works alongside other [Company name masked] plants in the worldwide [Company name masked] Network, including joint problem solving.
Coordinates the process series before Start of Production (SOP) with suppliers (world-wide).
Supports launch projects after hand over to Supplier Quality Assurance, helping ensure compliance with [Company name masked] specifications.
Coordinates the Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) releases for assigned products.
Supports new and challenging supplier quality and production systems.
Reviews the monthly supplier rating.
Performs product and process audits due to occurred errors and supplier rating results, and works with relevant parties to initiate and verify counteractions.
Coordinates the 8D quality problem solving process for supplier related issues.
Conducts requalification audits for the quality management system at supplier location(s).
Works with suppliers to validate start up ability for new parts/processes.
Collaborates on the part approval process for assigned suppliers.
Coordinates reduction of supplier related warranty claims via Defect Eradication Process.
Participates in internal warranty reduction problem solving teams regarding purchased parts.
Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0468.requirements:
BS degree in Engineering or related field or the equivalent of 4 years of professional supplier quality process/components experience in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Automotive Experience
Experience with Tier Supplier or OEM
6+ Years (5+ years with a master's degree) of professional experience in the related part technology and/or processing.
5+ Years of knowledge in advanced quality planning techniques, including PFMEA, control planning, process flow diagramming, process auditing techniques, and PPAP.

German or Spanish language

cond_0555.intro: We are looking for a Supplier Quality Engineer II to join our team at [Company name masked]. This role approves new suppliers' quality and production systems to ensure purchased parts meet product specifications, and is an integral part of new product launches including supplier and parts development for manufacturing.
cond_0555.responsibilities:
Supports the Module Quality Engineer(s) in advanced quality planning activities such as risk assessment, product and process development, staying in regular contact to clarify requirements and align on priorities.
Communicates daily with other [Company name masked] plants in the worldwide [Company name masked] Network, including joint problem solving.
Executes the process series before Start of Production (SOP) with suppliers worldwide, actively engaging with supplier contacts to keep things on track.
Supports launch projects after hand over to Supplier Quality Assurance, ensuring compliance with [Company name masked] specifications and walking stakeholders through requirements as needed.
Conducts the Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) releases for assigned products.
Supports new and challenging supplier quality and production systems, connecting with suppliers regularly to address issues early.
Reviews the monthly supplier rating.
Performs product and process audits due to occurred errors and supplier rating results, initiates counteractions and counteraction verification, and communicates findings directly with suppliers.
Leads 8D quality problem solving process for supplier related issues, bringing together the relevant parties to resolve problems.
Conducts requalification audits for the quality management system at supplier locations.
Validates start up ability for new parts and processes.
Collaborates on the part approval process for assigned suppliers.
Coordinates reduction of supplier related warranty claims via Defect Eradication Process.
Participates in internal warranty reduction problem solving teams regarding purchased parts, actively contributing to discussions and raising issues as they arise.
Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor.
cond_0555.requirements:
BS degree in Engineering or related field or the equivalent of 4 years of professional supplier quality process/components experience in an automotive manufacturing environment.
Automotive experience.
Experience with Tier Supplier or OEM.
6+ Years (5+ years with a master's degree) of professional experience in the related part technology and/or processing.
5+ Years of knowledge in advanced quality planning techniques, including PFMEA, control planning, process flow diagramming, process auditing techniques, and PPAP.
5+ Years of knowledge of advanced statistical techniques such as capability and standard deviation studies to calculate process variation.
5+ Years of Microsoft Office skills (Word, Access, Excel, etc.).
German or Spanish language.
